articles.title: Council Votes on Book Exchange Box After Long Debate
articles.deck: The money will be spent over the next year, with the first work starting in January.

articles.title: Canal Park Elementary Parents Organize Streetlight Upgrade
articles.deck: Principal Renee Radke said the school is grateful to families who volunteered this year.
body: Students will meet on Tuesday afternoons in the Foundry Row fire house, and transportation will be provided for those who need it. Principal Renee Radke said the program was built with help from parents and local volunteers.
The board will review the results at the end of the winter term. Sign-up forms went home in backpacks this week, and the first session is set for June.

articles.title: Theodore Nowicki, 95, Piano Teacher
articles.deck: Friends remember Theodore Nowicki for the many years of service to Canal Park.
body: Born in Canal Park in the years after the war, Theodore Nowicki spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Canal Park.
Theodore Nowicki died in December at home on Rail Street, at the age of 95. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Marsh Landing Pond Committee in his or her name.

articles.title: Letter: Thanks to the Marsh Landing Pond Committee
body: To the editor: I have lived on Dayton Road for 36 years, and I want to say what a difference the Marsh Landing Pond Committee has made. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Please keep the book exchange box in the budget. Many of us on Dayton Road use it every week. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the June meeting.
Isaac Rooney, Marsh Landing
